class.name: DisCreateEntityPdu
class.brief_description: Create Entity PDU (type 11): asks an application to create an entity.
class.description: A Create Entity PDU asks the application named by [member DisSimulationManagementPdu.receiving_id] to create an entity. It has no fields of its own beyond those of [DisSimulationManagementPdu] and is 28 bytes long. The receiver answers with a [DisAcknowledgePdu] carrying the same [member DisSimulationManagementPdu.request_id]. What gets created is up to the receiving game; [DisExerciseControl] only reports the request.

method.name: decode
method.description: Parses [param bytes] as a Create Entity PDU and returns it. Returns [code]null[/code] and sets [method DisPdu.get_last_error] if [param bytes] is not a valid Create Entity PDU (header shorter than 12 bytes, wrong PDU type, protocol version outside 1-7, length field larger than [code]bytes.size()[/code], or fewer than 28 bytes). A length field of 0 is replaced by the datagram size. Bytes after the last known field, up to the length field, are kept in [member DisPduBase.trailing_bytes].
